shopify.faqQ2: Does Jawab24 sync my Shopify products automatically?
shopify.faqA2: Yes. After connecting, Jawab24 imports your full product catalog and keeps it updated via webhooks.
shopify.faqQ3: Can Jawab24 reply in Arabic to Shopify store customers?
shopify.faqA3: Yes. Jawab24 detects 6 Arabic dialect families — Gulf, Egyptian, Levantine, Maghrebi, Iraqi, and MSA — and replies naturally in the customer's dialect.
